title: Semantics of the path program
statement: For a Boolean input $x$, a register bound $B$, a control label $\ell$, a register state $\sigma$, and a rational number $p$, the predicate holds exactly when the specified program has a path-or execution from initial configuration $(\ell,\sigma)$ on $x$, with register values bounded by $B$, and probability $p$.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define PSem, pathOr, or the register-bound relation, so their precise operational and probability conventions cannot be rendered faithfully.
